purpose: Safely branch invalid, expired, or forged proposal acceptance tokens and prevent proposal acceptance unless verification succeeds.

nodes.name: Security - Token Verified?
nodes.notes: TRUE may continue to the existing proposal acceptance logic. FALSE must not mutate acceptance state.

nodes.name: Security - Reject Invalid Accept Token
nodes.notes: Security failure branch. Do not update Odoo/PostgreSQL acceptance state from this branch.

integration_notes: Connect the TRUE output of Security - Token Verified? to the existing Module 2.5 proposal acceptance path.
Connect the FALSE output to Security - Reject Invalid Accept Token.

Replay protection requires persistent one-time-use state. This node intentionally does not invent a storage mechanism; add a database lookup/atomic consume step before acceptance if the master plan requires one-time tokens.
For production, write the rejection event to the existing audit/security-event path without storing the HMAC secret.
test_cases: token_verified=true => continues to existing acceptance path.
Rejected request does not mutate acceptance state.
